:::{#def-fibonacci-sequence}
#### Fibonacci sequence

The **Fibonacci sequence** $F_1, F_2, \ldots$
[@wikipedia_fibonacci_sequence]
is the [recursively defined sequence](#def-recursive-sequence) with $m = 2$,
initial [terms](functions.qmd#def-sequence-term) $F_1 = 1$ and $F_2 = 1$,
and recurrence $F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}$ for every [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) $n \ge 3$.

:::
